learning_outcomes.text: Understand Entropy and information. Basic issues.
Work with Engineering documents (MS-Word, Excel, OLE, etc.).
Work with TWAIN means (digital photo, scanner, text recognition, OCR).
Utilize Distance information services (OPAC, COMPENDEX, ISPEC, IRC, ICQ, FTP, teleconferences, etc.).
Understand Data-based systems and MS ACCESS for users (non-programmers). Fundamentals.
Understand Expert system ETS, types of problems, and demonstration in solutions.

syllabus_topics: Information systems and information technologies (IS/IT).
Essential types of information representation. Entropy. Basic computations.
Acquisition of information. Storing of information. Carriers of information. Information transfer.
Transfer channel. Quality of transfer channel. Information noise.
Electronic document, multi-medial information.
Multiplex channels.
Signals and signal carriers (telephone, optic, radio, laser, .).
Computer networks. Types. Communication protocols. Computer Network services.
Computer networks. Parameters of computer networks. Simulation.
Information technologies in the filed of Automatic Control. Data and Knowledge. Data-base systems, data models, data-base management, Engineering applications.
Design of data-base systems.
Knowledge-based systems. Representation of Knowledge. Computing with uncertainties.
Modular structure of expert system. Types of expert systems. Expert systems in engineering problem solving.
Future of information technologies and information systems in the époque of networks.
Entropy and information. Basic issues (tutorial).
Engineering document (MS-Word, Excel, OLE, etc.) (tutorial).
Development of technical presentation (MS-PowerPoint) (tutorial).
Work with TWAIN means (digital photo, scanner, text recognition, OCR) (tutorial).
Distance information services (OPAC, COMPENDEX, ISPEC, IRC, ICQ, FTP, teleconferences, etc.) (tutorial).
Data-based systems. MS ACCESS for users (non-programmers). Fundamentals (tutorial).
Expert system ETS. Types of problems. Demonstration in solutions (tutorial).
bibliography: Bíla, Král, Hlaváč: Information Technologies. Data-base and Knowledge-based systems. CTU in Prague, Prague, 2003.
degree: Oferta Erasmus+ en inglés de la Fac. de Ingeniería Mecánica (sin plan de grado atado)
